visual_logic.surface_detail: Ultra-smooth 'Jet Black' dorsal skin and 'Silver' belly, mimicking the countershading of a Great White Shark, running uniformly across its horizontal lateral flank.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. Hero focus remains on the 'Dolphin-like' snout and the high-fidelity render of the vertical, crescent-shaped tail fluke oriented parallel to the camera plane.
visual_logic.environment: The stagnant, oxygen-poor deep waters of the Posidonia Shale; water has an 'Ink Blue' tint with high clarity. The stylized 3D water splashes and surface transitions are shifted entirely into the background layers to maintain a sharp, measurable silhouette line.

pose: The ichthyosaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original mid-breach pose is unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, stretching its dolphin-like snout, streamlined body, fins, and crescent-shaped tail fluke end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
